findings.title: Separate masses become one rampart

findings.mechanism: The focus carrier رَدْمًا names closure of an opening, while 18:96 supplies compact masses, equalization between the sides, forced air, pouring, and metal; their contact changes the focus's request for a barrier into an integrated construction operation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the barrier is more than an unspecified wall: its unity is produced by alignment and transformation of parts.
findings.containment: The ordinary barrier between the two groups remains intact. The finding describes the supplied construction sequence and does not assert an engineering specification beyond it.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel supports are tied to the exact focus and 18:96 context, and each nominated branch has an exact contextual carrier in the packet.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold protection and impermanence together: the barrier is good in its present service while its endpoint remains outside the builder's control.
findings.containment: The ordinary completed barrier remains a real protective work. The HFT trace is legacy-unbound and attributed; the finding does not decide whether the demonstrative refers only to the barrier or to the wider episode, and it does not add an unstated chronology.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel evidence and exact 18:98 carriers support the relation, while the HFT source is legacy-unbound and its target morphology is not supplied, so the contextual synthesis remains qualified and attributed.

findings.title: The boundary also becomes an interface
findings.claim: Alongside its separating function, the jointly made barrier can be read as materializing an interface in the interval it closes.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers أَعِينُونِي, the doubled بَيْنَ, and رَدْمًا meet the attributed joining and equalization traces in 18:96; the contact adds a relational overlay to the barrier without removing its exclusionary function.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the construction as a jointly produced contact surface at the very interval where protection separates the sides.
findings.containment: The dominant physical function remains separation and controlled passage. This is a medium, legacy-unbound outlier carried as a relational overlay, not as a replacement for the wall.

epistemic.reason: The outlier has exact focus and 18:96 trace coordinates and an explicit containment note, but the source is legacy-unbound and one context branch is nominated without a full lexicon record.
